verdicts.reason: A: the Shop Sale button is jammed 12px from the left edge and practically touches the '20% off' headline, so the CTA comes before the message. The tiny can is stranded in the circle on the far right with a dead gap in the middle, and 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped from eyebrow to the bottom.
